p1: It was pouring when I saw a woman alone on Miller's Bridge, next to some dead flowers.
I pulled over. Hey, are you okay? She just climbed into my back seat.
I asked where she was heading. Nothing. Okay... I just started driving.
Then she started crying. In the mirror, she was shaking, staring right at me.
I pulled over and turned around. She was gone. Just a soaking wet seat.
At home, I checked my dashcam. The back seat was empty. But at the end, you can hear her whisper...
You didn't stop for me last time.
Two months ago, a woman waved at me on that bridge, in the rain. I didn't stop.
Now she's in every mirror. My car. My bathroom. My phone screen.
Always right behind me. And every night... a little closer.
Follow. And if you see her behind you, don't turn around.
